_note: The horses in the meadow across the road (our own model, tools/horse.py): each walks between its spots (x, z) and grazes at each for `graze` seconds, on the shared clock (horse i is i * 11 s ahead); you can ride them. Speeds in m/s; a gallop uses stamina (0..1 a second; back to galloping from `resume`); a jump clears `height` metres over `time` seconds. Shared by the browser and the server.
